Is there a reason IMS can't reprint the correct labels? Rich Brierley

Labels are applied when the product is received. If the storage period is extended—and we are notified of this extension—we re-label the items as the pallets are brought down to the lower levels of the racking system; since the pallets remain in the upper levels at all times, it is impossible to re-label them while they are still up on the top racks.
